_comment: Performance plan section B. W1/W2/W2b: FREE-tier workloads (P0). W4-W6: options PRO (options phase, first bounded definitions; sized by `live_p0 sizes` before any baseline). Shared with the Rust harness so both clients run identical requests. Every option request must stay under about 1M rows (vendor request-sizing guide).

W1.description: Bulk stock EOD backfill: one year for ten liquid symbols, one request per symbol.

W2.description: Option chain EOD for one day: every SPY contract (all expirations) on 2024-06-14. The expiration wildcard is unverified; W2b is the fallback.

W2b.description: Option chain EOD for one day and one expiration: SPY 2024-06-21 on 2024-06-14 (fallback if the expiration wildcard is rejected).

W4a.description: Option quotes at 1-minute for a chain: SPY on 2024-06-14, one request per expiration (4 expirations, every strike, both rights).

W4b.description: Option quotes at 1 s: SPY calls expiring 2024-06-21 on 2024-06-14, 10:00-10:30, every strike.

W5a.description: Tick trades for a liquid root day: SPY on 2024-06-14, one request per expiration (4 expirations).

W5b.description: Tick quotes, bounded first run: SPY calls expiring 2024-06-21 on 2024-06-14, 10:00-10:15, every strike.

W6a.description: Greeks at 1-minute: SPY expiring 2024-06-21 on 2024-06-14, every strike, both rights.

W6b.description: Trade Greeks: SPY expiring 2024-06-21 on 2024-06-14, every trade.
